results.title: Los Angeles County Intensifies Mosquito Spraying Amid Surge in West Nile Virus Cases
results.description: Health officials in Los Angeles County have increased mosquito spraying operations in response to a significant surge in West Nile virus infections, with over 100 cases reported this year. Warm overnight temperatures are driving high mosquito activity, prompting vector control crews to spray pesticides in affected areas like La Puente to mitigate the spread of the disease.
